subject: General Updates
text: Trading in equity shares of Jio Platforms Limited (JPL) will commence from October 28, 2026.Further, a meeting of board of directors of JPL is scheduled to be held on Friday, October 30, 2026, inter alia, to consider and approve the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results of JPL for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: The meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on October 30, 2026, inter alia, to consider and approve a. the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026; and b. raising of funds by way of issuance of listed, secured / unsecured, redeemable non-convertible debentures on private placement basis, in one or more tranches. The Company will hold an analyst meet, post the Board Meeting, to discuss the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
